buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Only the vendors complying with the four Labour Codes shall be eligible for bidding. Supporting documents shall be produced/enclosed by the bidders.

2. Geographic Presence- the bidder shall have a registered functional office in the di strict of Kamrup Metropolitan, Assam. 3. Remotely managed office in Kamrup Metropolitan district will not be entertained. 4. Existing Contractual Staff of this Tribunal may be retained by the selecte d vendor. 5. Vendors having experience of working with CAT/DRT/High Court will only be consid ered and they need to enclose documentary proof in this regard. 6. The years of past experience required for same and similar service for 3 years. 7. Staffs having experience of Working in CAT/DRT/High Court will be preferred. 8. Timely payment to the employed staffs must be ensured and done properly after t he Contract is awarded. 9. Vendor Should employ 20 or more workers during the accounting year. 10. Applicants for the post of DEO should have a Higher Secondary (10+2) or equivale nt qualification from a recognised Education Board of Central/State Govt. 11. Applicants for the post of DEO should be proficient in basic computer skills, with pro per knowledge of Word, Excel, etc., and should also hold an IT certificate. 12. Vacancy may be increased or curtailed as per the administrative requirement, with the approval of the Competent Authority. 13. The rate to be paid to the outsourcing staff shall not be less than the minimum Wage Rate notified by Govt. of India from time to time till the end of the contract. .
